name: Eärgon Salsa
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Slice peppers crosswise to form small rings, and put in a small container.
Add garlic, vinegar, and tomato paste.

culture.text: Eärgon salsa is an easy-to-make, low sodium hot sauce that nicely complements fresh vegetables like broccoli, carrots, and celery. Easy variations using hotter peppers such as seranos and habaneros are given below.
